picks.editorial_note: A combined $1.175B commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments on record, positioning Georgia as a national AI hub and signaling how seriously research universities are betting on AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium of 15 universities across 10 states pooling supercomputing resources marks a significant federal-academic push to decentralize AI compute access beyond the usual coastal hubs.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC leading a DOE Genesis Mission project to apply autonomous AI discovery to catalysis research could accelerate breakthroughs in clean energy chemistry, exemplifying the government's growing bet on AI-driven 'self-driving' science.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: Phase II DOE funding for Berkeley Lab's MOAT-Core project shows sustained federal commitment to AI-optimized particle accelerator design, with potential ripple effects across high-energy physics infrastructure nationwide.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project to build fully autonomous 'self-driving' laboratories represents a genuine shift in how experimental science could be conducted, with AI agents and robots running photon-science experiments with minimal human intervention.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide, broadens access to high-performance AI computing beyond elite institutions, addressing a key bottleneck in academic AI research.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two new DOE Genesis Mission awards apply AI to both microelectronics design and quantum information science, advancing foundational technologies that underpin future AI hardware.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: A $30M NSF center spanning UT Austin, MIT, Indiana, Tufts, Utah, and Yale to study human-robot co-adaptation reflects major federal investment in making AI-driven robotics safely integrate with human collaborators.
picks.title: Luddy researchers join new $30 million NSF Center to shape the future of human-robot co-adaptation

picks.editorial_note: CMU's Ataraxos system outperforming top humans at Stratego, a game defined by hidden information, published in Nature, is a notable scientific advance in AI's ability to handle imperfect-information decision-making.
picks.title: CMU Researchers Develop AI That Tackles Hidden Information in Stratego

picks.editorial_note: An NIH Director's Pioneer Award funding an AI-human discovery engine for cancer hypothesis generation at Weill Cornell signals growing institutional confidence in LLM agents as genuine scientific collaborators.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University
